--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/policy.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+"""Route authorization: enforce the policy of the matched route."""
+
+ROUTE_POLICY = {
+    "/admin": "admin",
+    "/billing": "editor",
+    "/public": "viewer",
+}
+
+ROLE_RANK = {"viewer": 0, "editor": 1, "admin": 2}
+
+
+def authorize(session, path):
+    """Allow the request when its role satisfies the matched route policy."""
+    matched = session.get("route", "/public")
+    required = ROUTE_POLICY.get(matched, "viewer")
+    return ROLE_RANK.get(session.get("role", "viewer"), 0) >= ROLE_RANK[required]
diff --git a/tests/test_policy.py b/tests/test_policy.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..fa28aa74a1522dd483dbc4b19fd69b211209f386

+++ b/tests/test_policy.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+from src.policy import authorize
+
+
+def test_admin_requires_admin_role():
+    assert not authorize({"role": "viewer", "route": "/admin"}, "/admin")
+
+
+def test_public_allows_viewer():
+    assert authorize({"role": "viewer", "route": "/public"}, "/public")
